description_en: Modifies a service resource of a zone to which an endpoint connection belongs
description_zh: 调用UpdateVpcEndpointZoneConnectionResourceAttribute接口，替换终端节点可用区连接服务资源
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink update-vpc-endpoint-zone-connection-resource-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id epsrv-hp3vpx8yqxblby3i0000 --endpoint-id ep-hp33b2e43fays7s80000 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateVpcEndpointZoneConnectionResourceAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoint connection whose bandwidth you want to modify.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的终端节点连接带宽的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The resource allocation mode. You can change the resource allocation mode only if the endpoint connection is in the Disconnected state. Valid values:

Auto: automatically and randomly allocates service resources. In this mode, the specified service resource is deleted.

Manual: manually allocates service resources. If you set the value to Manual, you must also specify the ResourceId and ResourceType parameters
parameters.help_zh:
资源分配模式，只能在终端节点连接处于已断开时调整资源分配模式。取值：

Auto：自动分配服务资源（随机分配），此时会清除已经指定的服务资源。

Manual：手动分配服务资源，此时必须输入ResourceId和ResourceType参数
parameters.name: resource_allocate_mode

parameters.help_en:
The migration mode of the service resource. Valid values:

Graceful: smooth migration. Service resources in the zone are smoothly migrated.

Force: forced migration. Service resources in the zone are forcefully migrated.

You need to specify this parameter only if you want to migrate service resources and the endpoint connection is in the Connected state. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify the ResourceId and ResourceType parameters
parameters.help_zh:
服务资源迁移方式。取值：

Graceful：平滑迁移，此时可用区连接平滑迁移服务资源。

Force：强制迁移，此时可用区连接强制迁移服务资源。


只能在终端节点连接处于已连接且需要迁移服务资源时输入此参数，此时必须输入ResourceId和ResourceType参数。
parameters.name: resource_replace_mode

parameters.help_en:
The type of the service resource. Valid values:

slb: a CLB instance that supports PrivateLink. In addition, the CLB instance is deployed in a VPC.

alb: an Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance that supports PrivateLink. In addition, the ALB instance is deployed in a VPC.

If ResourceAllocateMode is set to Mannual, or ResourceReplaceMode is set, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
服务资源类型。取值：

slb：表示服务资源类型为专有网络类型且支持PrivateLink功能的传统型负载均衡CLB（Classic Load Balancer）。

alb：表示服务资源类型为专有网络类型且支持PrivateLink功能的应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）。

当ResourceAllocateMode为Manual或指定ResourceReplaceMode参数时，此参数必选
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the service resource that you want to manually allocate or migrate in the zone where the endpoint connection is deployed.

If ResourceAllocateMode is set to Mannual, or ResourceReplaceMode is set, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点连接所在可用区手动分配或迁移的服务资源ID。

当ResourceAllocateMode为Manual或指定ResourceReplaceMode参数时，此参数必选
parameters.name: resource_id
